title: KLA Corporation
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Detailed fundamental analysis and growth catalysts for KLA Corporation (KLAC) are currently under review.

Future Tech Roadmap

2nm Process Node (TSMC N2) Confident 2025
Leading-edge silicon node; volume production 2025: TSMC N2, Samsung SF2
📈 TSMC N2 is in volume production. Apple and NVIDIA are lead customers. Node leadership translates directly to pricing power and customer lock-in.
KEY SUPPLIER · 75% enables: TSM 99% · ASML 90%
1nm / A14 Process Node Researching 2027
Sub-2nm node requiring High-NA EUV; TSMC A14 targeting 2028
📈 TSMC A14 is in early development: risk production targeted 2026, volume by 2028. Success cements TSMC node leadership for another generation and extends ASML EUV equipment demand.
KEY SUPPLIER · 78% enables: ASML 95% · TSM 85%
